title: River Barges at Dawn
subtitle: The Lockhouse Manifests
summary: Myra and Orsen track Fennick's clerks through rain-slicked alleys to recover the private river-barge registers.

c5_start.speaker: orsen
c5_start.text: Before curfew bells rang, two hired carters loaded iron crates from the back alley behind the fountain. No guild escort, just heavy tarps.

c5_rainy_trail.speaker: myra
c5_rainy_trail.text: Wheel ruts turn east toward the canal lockhouse. Rain's filling the grooves fast—we cut through the brick alley now or lose them.

c5_alley_lockmaster.speaker: torrik
c5_alley_lockmaster.text: Wait—the lockhouse clerk dropped his satchel under the wall lantern! And Nova's already holding the gate shut.

c5_nova_explain.speaker: nova
c5_nova_explain.text: He's no mercenary. Fennick threatened to foreclose his mother's mill if he didn't sign false sluice passes. He'll hand over the barge ledger if you keep his name off the arrest warrant.

c5_lockmaster_choice.speaker: torrik
c5_lockmaster_choice.text: The trembling clerk clutches the oiled-leather barge register beneath the flickering lantern.

choices.label: Guarantee his protection as a witness in exchange for the full ledger
Confiscate the ledger outright and turn him over to the watch

c5_spare_yes.speaker: nova
c5_spare_yes.text: He gave you the dockside routing codes too. All twelve barges were bound for private granaries upriver before turning north to profiteers.

c5_spare_no.speaker: orsen
c5_spare_no.text: We got the book, though half the dockhands scattered when the watch blew their whistles. Next stop is the forge—we need iron axles ready before morning.
